name: tau-canvas
description: What a run makes for you to look at, in a pane beside it

tools.name: canvas_edit
tools.description: Revises a document on the canvas by exact replacements: each `old` must occur exactly once in the text as the edits before it left it, and becomes `new`. The result is a new revision; the person can step back through earlier ones.

items.description: An exact replacement in a document.

old.description: Text that occurs exactly once in the document, as the edits before this one left it.

item.description: The document to revise, by its number.

title.description: A new title, if it changes.

tools.name: canvas_read
tools.description: Reads a document's text from the canvas: its latest revision, or `revision`, numbered from 1. An image reads as its title, caption and file.

item.description: The document to read, by its number.

revision.description: The revision to read, from 1. Leave it out for the latest.

tools.name: canvas_show
tools.description: Shows the person an image file on the canvas, a pane beside the conversation. Use it for a picture they should look at: a chart you plotted, a screenshot, a diagram you rendered. The file must be PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP or SVG, at most 8 MiB. The canvas keeps a copy, so the file may change afterwards. Give `item` to replace an image on the canvas with a new version; leave it out to add one.

caption.description: A line under the image saying what it shows.

item.description: The image on the canvas to replace with a new version, by its number. Leave it out to add a new image.

path.description: The image file: relative to the workspace, absolute, or from home with `~/`.

title.description: A short title for the image.

tools.name: canvas_write
tools.description: Writes a Markdown document on the canvas, a pane beside the conversation, for the person to read: a plan, a report, a draft, anything longer than a reply that they will want to keep open while you talk. Give `item` to replace a document's whole text with a new revision; leave it out to start a new document. To change part of a document, use canvas_edit.

item.description: The document on the canvas whose text this replaces, as a new revision, by its number. Leave it out to start a new document.
